# Miataru server time-based location updates (2026-01-20 19:24Z)

_**User**_

right now an update to the miataru server of the devices location will only be sent if the location has changed. I want to add another criteria: Time. 

Even if the location has not changed the app should send an update of location, battery etc. to the server at least every 2-3 hours.

---

_**Agent (model default, mode Plan)**_


Researching how location updates are sent to the server and where location change detection occurs.

        "contents": "    private func sendLocationToServer(_ location: CLLocation) {\n        guard isNetworkAvailable else {\n            debugLog(\"No network available, skipping server update.\")\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"No network connection\")\n            return\n        }\n        guard !settings.miataruServerURL.isEmpty,\n              let serverURL = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL) else {\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"Invalid server configuration\")\n            return\n        }\n        guard let payload = sanitizedPayload(from: location) else {\n            debugLog(\"[LocationManager] Skipping server update due to invalid location values\")\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"Invalid location values\")\n            return\n        }\n        self.serverUpdateStatus = .updating\n        Task {\n            do {\n                let success = try await MiataruAPIClient.updateLocation(\n                    serverURL: serverURL,\n                    locationData: payload,\n                    enableHistory: settings.saveLocationHistoryOnServer,\n                    retentionTime: settings.locationDataRetentionTime\n                )\n                if success {\n                    self.serverUpdateStatus = .success\n                    self.lastServerUpdate = Date()\n                    NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .didSendOwnLocationUpdate, object: nil)\n                } else {\n                    self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"Server response was not successful\")\n                }\n            } catch {\n                self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(error.localizedDescription)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n\n    /// Creates a sanitized payload to avoid encoding failures from NaN/inf values.\n    private func sanitizedPayload(from location: CLLocation) -&gt; UpdateLocationPayload? {\n        let longitude = location.coordinate.longitude",

        "contents": "    ///   - locationData: The location data to be sent to the server.\n    ///   - enableHistory: Whether the server should store location history for this device.\n    ///   - retentionTime: The time in minutes for the server to retain this location data.\n    /// - Returns: A boolean indicating if the server acknowledged the update.\n    /// - Throws: An &#96;APIError&#96; if the request fails.\n    public static func updateLocation(serverURL: URL,\n                              locationData: UpdateLocationPayload,\n                              enableHistory: Bool,\n                              retentionTime: Int) async throws -&gt; Bool {\n                                  \n        let url = serverURL.appendingPathComponent(\"v1/UpdateLocation\")\n\n        var locationDict: [String: Any] = [\n            \"Device\": locationData.Device,\n            \"Timestamp\": locationData.Timestamp,\n            \"Longitude\": locationData.Longitude,\n            \"Latitude\": locationData.Latitude,\n            \"HorizontalAccuracy\": locationData.HorizontalAccuracy\n        ]\n        if let speed = locationData.Speed { locationDict[\"Speed\"] = speed }\n        if let battery = locationData.BatteryLevel { locationDict[\"BatteryLevel\"] = battery }\n        if let altitude = locationData.Altitude { locationDict[\"Altitude\"] = altitude }\n\n        let jsonPayload: [String: Any] = [\n            \"MiataruConfig\": [\n                \"EnableLocationHistory\": String(enableHistory),\n                \"LocationDataRetentionTime\": String(retentionTime)\n            ],\n            \"MiataruLocation\": [locationDict]\n        ]\n        \n        let data = try await performPostRequest(url: url, jsonPayload: jsonPayload)\n        \n        do {\n            let response = try jsonDecoder.decode(MiataruUpdateLocationResponse.self, from: data)\n            return response.MiataruResponse == \"ACK\"\n        } catch {\n            throw APIError.decodingError(error)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Private Helper\n    \n    private static func performPostRequest(url: URL,\n                                          jsonPayload: [String: Any],\n                                          logMessage: ((String) -&gt; String)? = nil) async throws -&gt; Data {",

= nil, speed: Double? = nil) {\n        if let idx = locations.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) {\n            let existing = locations[idx]\n            let moved = existing.latitude != latitude || existing.longitude != longitude\n            let updated = CachedDeviceLocation(\n                deviceID: deviceID,\n                latitude: latitude,\n                longitude: longitude,\n                accuracy: accuracy,\n                timestamp: timestamp,\n                // Preserve previous placemark to avoid UI flicker; will be updated by geocoding\n                country: existing.country,\n                locality: existing.locality,\n                timeZone: existing.timeZone,\n                batteryLevel: batteryLevel,\n                altitude: altitude,\n                speed: speed ??         "contents": "    private func sendLocationToServer(_ location: CLLocation) {\n        guard isNetworkAvailable else {\n            debugLog(\"No network available, skipping server update.\")\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"No network connection\")\n            return\n        }\n        guard !settings.miataruServerURL.isEmpty,\n              let serverURL = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL) else {\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"Invalid server configuration\")\n            return\n        }\n        guard let payload = sanitizedPayload(from: location) else {\n            debugLog(\"[LocationManager] Skipping server update due to invalid location values\")\n            self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"Invalid location values\")\n            return\n        }\n        self.serverUpdateStatus = .updating\n        Task {\n            do {\n                let success = try await MiataruAPIClient.updateLocation(\n                    serverURL: serverURL,\n                    locationData: payload,\n                    enableHistory: settings.saveLocationHistoryOnServer,\n                    retentionTime: settings.locationDataRetentionTime\n                )\n                if success {\n                    self.serverUpdateStatus = .success\n                    self.lastServerUpdate = Date()\n                    NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .didSendOwnLocationUpdate, object: nil)\n                } else {\n                    self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(\"Server response was not successful\")\n                }\n            } catch {\n                self.serverUpdateStatus = .failed(error.localizedDescription)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n\n    /// Creates a sanitized payload to avoid encoding failures from NaN/inf values.\n    private func sanitizedPayload(from location: CLLocation) -&gt; UpdateLocationPayload? {\n        let longitude = location.coordinate.longitude",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * DeviceLocationRefresher.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport UIKit\nimport MiataruAPIClient\n\n/// DeviceLocationRefresher handles refreshing device locations from the server with throttling support.\nfinal class DeviceLocationRefresher {\n    static let shared = DeviceLocationRefresher()\n    \n    // MARK: - Private Properties\n    private var lastRefresh: Date?\n    private let settings = SettingsManager.shared\n    private let store = KnownDeviceStore.shared\n    private let cache = DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared\n    \n    // MARK: - Init\n    private init() {}\n    \n    // MARK: - Public Methods\n    \n    /// Checks if a refresh should be performed based on throttling, visibility, app state, and settings.\n    /// - Parameter isVisible: Whether the view requesting the refresh is currently visible\n    /// - Returns: &#96;true&#96; if refresh should proceed, &#96;false&#96; otherwise\n    func shouldRefresh(isVisible: Bool) async -&gt; Bool {\n        guard settings.autoRefreshDeviceList,\n              isVisible else {\n            return false\n        }\n        \n        // Check application state on main thread\n        let isActive = await MainActor.run {\n            UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active\n        }\n        \n        guard isActive else {\n            return false\n        }\n        \n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\n        let now = Date()\n        \n        if let last = lastRefresh, now.timeIntervalSince(last) &lt; interval {\n            // Throttle: do not refresh yet\n            return false\n        }\n        \n        return true\n    }\n    \n    /// Refreshes all device locations if conditions are met (throttling, visibility, app state).\n    /// - Parameters:\n    ///   - isVisible: Whether the view requesting the refresh is currently visible\n    ///   - forceGeocoding: Whether to force geocoding for all devices\n    /// - Returns: &#96;true&#96; if refresh was performed and succeeded, &#96;false&#96; otherwise\n    func refreshIfNeeded(isVisible: Bool, forceGeocoding: Bool = false) async -&gt; Bool {\n        ",

if refresh should proceed, &#96;false&#96; otherwise\n    func shouldRefresh(isVisible: Bool) async -&gt; Bool {\n        guard settings.autoRefreshDeviceList,\n              isVisible else {\n            return false\n        }\n        \n        // Check application state on main thread\n        let isActive = await MainActor.run {\n            UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active\n        }\n        \n        guard isActive else {\n            return false\n        }\n        \n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\n        let now = Date()\n        \n        if let last = lastRefresh, now.timeIntervalSince(last) &lt; interval {\n            // Throttle: do not refresh yet\n            return false\n        }\n        \n        return true\n    }\n    \n    /// Refreshes all device locations if conditions are met (throttling, visibility, app state).\n    /// - Parameters:\n    ///   - isVisible: Whether the view requesting the refresh is currently visible\n    ///   - forceGeocoding: Whether to force geocoding for all devices\n    /// - Returns: &#96;true&#96; if refresh was performed and succeeded, &#96;false&#96; otherwise\n    func refreshIfNeeded(isVisible: Bool, forceGeocoding: Bool = false) async -&gt; Bool {\n        ",

        "contents": "    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Server Update Status\n    enum ServerUpdateStatus {\n        case idle\n        case updating\n        case success\n        case failed(String)\n    }\n    \n    struct UpdateLogEntry: Identifiable {\n        let id = UUID()\n        let timestamp: Date\n        let mode: String\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Init\n    override private init() {\n        super.init()\n        locationManager.delegate = self\n        locationManager.allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates = true\n        locationManager.pausesLocationUpdatesAutomatically = false\n        locationManager.showsBackgroundLocationIndicator = false\n        locationManager.activityType = Self.activityTypeFrom(settings.locationActivityType)\n        // Enable battery monitoring to report battery percentage with location updates\n        UIDevice.current.isBatteryMonitoringEnabled = true\n        observeSettings()\n        NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(self, selector: #selector(appDidBecomeActive), name: UIApplication.didBecomeActiveNotification, object: nil)\n        observeActivityType()\n        networkMonitor.pathUpdateHandler = { [weak self] path in\n            Task { @MainActor in\n                self?.isNetworkAvailable = (path.status == .satisfied)\n            }\n        }\n        let queue = DispatchQueue(label: \"NetworkMonitor\")\n        networkMonitor.start(queue: queue)\n        // Ensure permission state is handled on startup\n        ensureAuthorizationIfNeeded()\n        // Load persisted background update metrics\n        if userDefaults.object(forKey: backgroundUpdateCountKey) != nil {\n            backgroundUpdateCount = userDefaults.integer(forKey: backgroundUpdateCountKey)\n        }\n        if let savedDate = userDefaults.object(forKey: lastBackgroundUpdateKey) as? Date {\n            lastBackgroundUpdate = savedDate\n        }\n        // Perform initial daily reset check\n        maybeResetBackgroundMetricsIfNeeded()\n    }\n    \n    deinit {\n        NotificationCenter.default.removeObserver(self)\n    }\n    \n    @objc private func appDidBecomeActive() {\n        debugLog(\"App did become active\")\n        // Update authorization status (in case it changed while app was in background)",

Data(contentsOf: url) else { return nil }\n        do {\n            return try JSONDecoder().decode(SharedWidgetConfig.self, from: data)\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Failed to decode shared widget config: \\(error)\")\n            return nil\n        }\n    }\n}",

Data(contentsOf: fileURL) else { return [] }\n        do {\n            if let groups = try NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(ofClasses: [NSArray.self, DeviceGroup.self], from: data) as? [DeviceGroup] {\n                // Nach gespeicherter Reihenfolge sortieren\n                return groups.sorted { $0.groupPosition &lt; $1.groupPosition }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"Fehler beim Laden der DeviceGroups: \\(error)\")\n        }\n        return []\n    }\n\n    func add(group: DeviceGroup) {\n        groups.append(group)\n    }\n\n    func move(fromOffsets source: IndexSet, toOffset destination: Int) {\n        groups.move(fromOffsets: source, toOffset: destination)",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * KnownDeviceStore.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport UIKit\nimport Combine\n\n// Falls erforderlich, KnownDevice importieren (bei getrennten Modulen):\n// import miataru\n\nclass KnownDeviceStore: ObservableObject {\n    static let shared = KnownDeviceStore()\n    \n    @Published var devices: [KnownDevice] = [] {\n        didSet {\n            guard !isInitializing else { return }\n            setupSubscribers()\n            save()\n            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()\n        }\n    }\n    private let fileName = \"knownDevices.plist\"\n    private var cancellables: [AnyCancellable] = []\n    private var isInitializing = true\n\n    private var fileURL: URL {\n        AppDirectories.applicationSupportFile(named: fileName)\n    }\n\n    // Make init private for singleton\n    private init() {\n        self.devices = load()\n        // Sicherstellen, dass das eigene Gerät immer in der Liste ist\n        let myDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n        if !self.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == myDeviceID }) {\n            let myDeviceName = NSLocalizedString(\"my_device\", comment: \"Name for the user's own device in the device list\")\n            let myDevice = KnownDevice(name: myDeviceName, deviceID: myDeviceID, color: UIColor.systemBlue)\n            self.devices.insert(myDevice, at: 0)\n            debugLog(\"[DEBUG] Eigenes Gerät mit DeviceID \\(myDeviceID) wurde automatisch als erstes Device hinzugefügt.\")\n            save()\n        }\n        setupSubscribers()\n        isInitializing = false\n    }\n\n    private func setupSubscribers() {\n        cancellables = []\n        for device in devices {\n            ",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * AppDirectories.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\n\n/// Helper methods for dealing with filesystem locations specific to the app.\n///\n/// Currently this type exposes a convenience method for creating paths inside the\n/// app's \"Application Support\" directory.  Centralizing the logic ensures that\n/// every component writes to the same location and the directory gets created when needed.\nenum AppDirectories {\n    /// Returns a file URL inside the application's Application Support folder, creating the folder if needed.\n    /// - Parameter fileName: The name of the file.\n    /// - Returns: The full URL to the file within the application's support directory.\n    static func applicationSupportFile(named fileName: String) -&gt; URL {\n        let fileManager = FileManager.default\n\n        // Base location for all Application Support files.\n        let appSupportURL = fileManager.urls(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]\n\n        // Use the bundle identifier to create an app-specific subdirectory so our\n        // files don't collide with those from other apps.\n        let bundleID = Bundle.main.bundleIdentifier ?? \"DefaultApp\"\n        let appDirectory = appSupportURL.appendingPathComponent(bundleID)\n\n        // Create the directory if it doesn't already exist.\n        if !fileManager.fileExists(atPath: appDirectory.path) {\n            try? fileManager.createDirectory(at: appDirectory, withIntermediateDirectories: true, attributes: nil)\n        }\n\n        // Append the desired file name to obtain the final file URL.\n        return appDirectory.appendingPathComponent(fileName)\n    }\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

              "file": "./.specstory/history/2025-09-10_10-10Z-warum-wird-die-zeit-nicht-aktualisiert.md",
              "matches": [
                {
                  "lineNumber": 286,
                  "content": "When I set &#96;now&#96;, it should trigger a full recomposition of the body, including the Map annotations, and that should update. However, it seems there was a performance issue where updates are not happening every second as expected. In &#96;iPhone_DeviceNavigationView&#96;, &#96;timeUpdateTimer&#96; is set as an @State variable, which restarts with the map update interval. If &#96;settings.mapUpdateInterval&#96; is greater than 1 second, it could lead to updates happening only at that interval—such as every 30 seconds—rather than continuously, which is different from the 1-second timer used earlier in &#96;iPhone_DeviceMapView&#96;."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 304,
                  "content": "I’m noticing a concrete issue with the &#96;timeUpdateTimer&#96; in &#96;iPhone_DeviceNavigationView&#96;. It’s defined as a state variable that automatically connects, but when the &#96;settings.mapUpdateInterval&#96; changes, the new publisher is assigned without canceling the previous one. This might mean that the old timer could still emit values without being properly bound, which doesn't cause updates."
                }
              ]

{
  "plan": "# Implementation Plan: Periodic Location Updates\n\n## Overview\n\nCurrently, &#96;LocationManager&#96; only sends location updates to the server when the location changes significantly (based on distance/accuracy thresholds). This plan adds a time-based criteria: updates will also be sent periodically at a user-configurable interval (1-24 hours), even if the location hasn't changed. This ensures battery level and other metadata stay current on the server.\n\n## Architecture\n\nThe implementation will modify the location update decision logic in &#96;LocationManager.swift&#96; to check both:\n1. **Location change criteria** (existing): Distance/accuracy thresholds\n2. **Time-based criteria** (new): Time elapsed since last server update\n\n## Implementation Details\n\n### 1. Add Setting for Periodic Update Interval\n\n**File**: &#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/SettingsManager.swift&#96;\n\n- Add new &#96;@Published&#96; property &#96;periodicLocationUpdateIntervalHours: Int&#96; (range: 1-24 hours)\n- Store in UserDefaults with key &#96;periodic_location_update_interval_hours&#96;\n- Default value: 2 hours (120 minutes)\n- Add key to &#96;Keys&#96; enum\n\n### 2. Persist Last Server Update Time\n\n**File**: &#96;miataru/LocationManagers/LocationManager.swift&#96;\n\n- Currently &#96;lastServerUpdate&#96; is only in memory (&#96;@Published var lastServerUpdate: Date?&#96;)\n- Add UserDefaults persistence for &#96;lastServerUpdate&#96; so it survives app restarts\n- Load persisted value in &#96;init()&#96;\n- Save value whenever &#96;lastServerUpdate&#96; is set (in &#96;sendLocationToServer&#96;)\n\n### 3. Modify Location Update Logic\n\n**File**: &#96;miataru/LocationManagers/LocationManager.swift&#96;\n\nIn &#96;locationManager(_:didUpdateLocations:)&#96; method (around line 497):\n\n- After checking location change criteria (lines 512-532), add a time-based check\n- If location update was NOT accepted based on distance/accuracy, check if enough time has passed since &#96;lastServerUpdate&#96;\n- Calculate time threshold: &#96;settings.periodicLocationUpdateIntervalHours * 3600&#96; seconds\n- If &#96;lastServerUpdate == nil&#96; OR &#96;timeSinceLastUpdate &gt;= threshold&#96;, accept the update and send to server\n- This ensures periodic updates even when stationary\n\n### 4. Add UI Setting\n\n**File**: &#96;miataru/views/iPhone/Settings Views/iPhone_SettingsView.swift&#96;\n\n- Add new Picker in the \"activity_type_accuracy_settings_title\" section (after location sensitivity picker, around line 69)\n- Picker options: 1 hour, 2 hours, 3 hours, 4 hours, 6 hours, 8 hours, 12 hours, 24 hours\n- Use localized strings for labels\n- Add explanation text below the picker\n\n### 5. Add Localization Strings\n\n**File**: &#96;miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings&#96;\n\nAdd new localization keys for all 10 supported languages:\n- &#96;periodic_location_update_interval_title&#96;: \"Periodic location update interval\"\n- &#96;periodic_location_update_interval_explanation&#96;: \"Even if your location hasn't changed, the app will send updates to the server at least this often. This ensures battery level and other information stays current.\"\n- Individual hour labels: &#96;periodic_update_1_hour&#96;, &#96;periodic_update_2_hours&#96;, etc.\n\n### 6. Background Considerations\n\nThe existing significant location change monitoring in background mode will continue to work. When a significant location change occurs, the time check will also run. For truly stationary devices, the next significant location change (which can be triggered by iOS when the device moves even slightly) will trigger the time-based update.\n\n## Files to Modify\n\n1. &#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/SettingsManager.swift&#96; - Add new setting property\n2. &#96;miataru/LocationManagers/LocationManager.swift&#96; - Add time-based check and persist lastServerUpdate\n3. &#96;miataru/views/iPhone/Settings Views/iPhone_SettingsView.swift&#96; - Add UI picker\n4. &#96;miataru/Assets/Localizable.xcstrings&#96; - Add localization strings\n\n## Testing Considerations\n\n- Verify updates are sent when time threshold is reached even if location hasn't changed\n- Verify updates are still sent immediately when location changes significantly\n- Verify setting persists across app restarts\n- Verify &#96;lastServerUpdate&#96; persists across app restarts\n- Test with different interval values (1 hour, 24 hours)\n- Verify behavior in both foreground and background modes",

All tasks are complete. Summary of changes:

## Implementation Summary

1. **Added Setting to SettingsManager** (`SettingsManager.swift`)
   - Added `periodicLocationUpdateIntervalHours` property with UserDefaults persistence
   - Default value: 2 hours
   - Added key to the `Keys` enum

2. **Persisted Last Server Update** (`LocationManager.swift`)
   - Added `lastServerUpdateKey` constant
   - Load persisted `lastServerUpdate` in `init()`
   - Save `lastServerUpdate` to UserDefaults when a server update succeeds

3. **Modified Location Update Logic** (`LocationManager.swift`)
   - Added time-based check in `locationManager(_:didUpdateLocations:)`
   - If location change criteria aren't met, check if enough time has passed since `lastServerUpdate`
   - Calculates threshold: `settings.periodicLocationUpdateIntervalHours * 3600` seconds
   - Accepts and sends update if threshold is exceeded, even if location hasn't changed

4. **Added UI Picker** (`iPhone_SettingsView.swift`)
   - Added Picker in the location tracking settings section
   - Options: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, and 24 hours
   - Includes localized title and explanation text

5. **Added Localization Strings** (`Localizable.xcstrings`)
   - Added strings for all 10 supported languages (en, de, da, es, fi, fr, it, ja, nl, zh-Hans):
     - `periodic_location_update_interval_title`
     - `periodic_location_update_interval_explanation`
     - `periodic_update_1_hour` through `periodic_update_24_hours`

The implementation ensures that location updates (including battery level and other metadata) are sent to the server periodically based on the user-configured interval, even when the device is stationary. The time-based check works alongside the existing distance/accuracy-based criteria, so updates are sent when either condition is met.

## Changes Made

1. **Added "Off" option to UI picker** (`iPhone_SettingsView.swift`)
   - Added "Off" as the first option with value `0` in the periodic update interval picker

2. **Updated logic to respect "Off" setting** (`LocationManager.swift`)
   - Modified the time-based check to only run if `periodicLocationUpdateIntervalHours > 0`
   - When set to 0 (Off), periodic updates are disabled
   - Added debug logging when periodic updates are disabled

3. **Added localization for "Off"** (`Localizable.xcstrings`)
   - Added `periodic_update_off` string with translations for all 10 languages:
     - English: "Off"
     - German: "Aus"
     - Danish: "Slukket"
     - Spanish: "Desactivado"
     - Finnish: "Pois päältä"
     - French: "Désactivé"
     - Italian: "Disattivato"
     - Japanese: "オフ"
     - Dutch: "Uit"
     - Chinese (Simplified): "关闭"

When "Off" is selected, the app only sends location updates when the location changes significantly (based on distance/accuracy thresholds), not based on time. The default remains 2 hours, but users can disable periodic updates by selecting "Off".
